title: Retirement waits for every dependency
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Attempt early retirement; unresolved users/work/retention must reject it.
preconditions: JavaScript enabled; open index.html directly in a browser

syntheticInput: Nine allowlisted fixed inventories; seven deterministic actions; three predictions; four retained rehearsals with six attempts and fourteen trace events each.
expectedAssertions: Each traffic, user, work, state ownership and rollback-retention dependency independently rejects retirement
Missing observations hold retirement and count UNKNOWN; a known blocker dominates uncertainty
Only all observed clear dependencies and expired synthetic retention permit SIMULATED_RETIRED
Rejected and unknown attempts remain in the denominator and full retained trace
Invalid input, order, repetition and bounds reject atomically

limits: Retirement is teaching-trace data only; no real resource, file or shell operations
